vehicle.title: Pick your car
vehicle.hint: Choose your model on the Vehicle tab, or keep Auto / Generic for any OBD2 car.

connect.title: Connect the adapter
connect.hint: Plug the adapter into the OBD2 port, switch the ignition on, then scan below.

faults.title: Read fault codes
faults.hint: Open the Faults tab to read stored, pending and permanent trouble codes.
